items.claim: The pick index keeping deleted nodes' exact boxes
The 3D marquee ignoring the asking view's `viewId`
`camera.pinchDolly` subtracting the pane origin from a centroid that is already view-local
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made, so I made it and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: the camera dep's `origin` now applies only to the wheel. A host that draws its 3D pane as a sub-rect of a plain canvas, with no `<CanvasView>`, would now get a pinch anchored off by that origin.

items.claim: The line pass dropping a segment that straddles the near plane
items.note: The segment is now clipped where it crosses the near plane, and a head whose tip is past it is not drawn. I rewrote the browser test that pinned the old dropping. That test fails on the frozen shader and passes on the new one.

A level drag under a tilted `up` overwriting one world axis
